concept: AWS Budgets: alerts on forecasted spend
tests: Which service lets you set a spend threshold and get alerts when actual or forecasted costs exceed it.
expected: AWS Budgets — cost/usage budgets with alerts on actual and forecasted spend. Triggers: "custom alerts", "projected monthly costs exceed a threshold".
why_not: Trusted Advisor gives recommendations, not budget alerts; CUR — raw billing data; CloudWatch billing widgets — visualization without flexible forecast alerts.
